name: shader_7b858d
vertexShader: attribute float aS; attribute float aA; varying float vA; void main(){ vA = aA; vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.); gl_PointSize = aS * 700. / max(.5, -mv.z); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }
fragmentShader: uniform vec3 uC; varying float vA; void main(){ float d = length(gl_PointCoord - .5) * 2.; float a = vA * smoothstep(1., .2, d); if (a < .01) discard; gl_FragColor = vec4(uC, a); }
